title: 污泥厭氧消化~Anaerobic sludge digestion
focus: 水解、酸化、產甲烷與能源收支~Hydrolysis, acidogenesis, methanogenesis and energy balances
summary: 本課以水解、酸化、產甲烷與能源收支為主線，從進料乾固體基準、有機容積負荷、有效消化時間、揮發固體轉化進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops hydrolysis, acidogenesis, methanogenesis and energy balances through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry-solids basis, organic volumetric loading, effective digestion time, volatile-solids conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 進料乾固體基準~Feed dry-solids basis
units.mechanism: 體積進料必須換算乾固體及揮發固體，才可比較不同污泥。~Convert feed volume to dry and volatile solids before comparing sludges.
units.model: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。~Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「進料乾固體基準」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed dry-solids basis. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 含水率變動掩蓋有機負荷增加。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。~Moisture changes can mask organic-load increases. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
units.misconception: 相同進料體積必有相同有機物量。~Equal feed volumes have equal organic mass.
units.practice: 只改變 TS:0.04→0.05，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2000 變為 2500 kg DS/d。用「進料乾固體基準」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TS:0.04→0.05, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2000 to 2500 kg DS/d. Explain the direction using feed dry-solids basis, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 有機容積負荷~Organic volumetric loading
units.mechanism: 酸化與產甲烷速度不一致時，進料增加可能先累積酸。~When acidogenesis and methanogenesis differ, increased feeding may accumulate acids first.
units.model: 原創教學假設：VS 進料=1500 kg/d；消化容積=1000 m³。模型 OLR=MVS/V，代入得到 1.5 kg VS/(m³·d)。適用邊界：只描述有機負荷，不代表可承受上限；VS 與 COD 不可混稱。~Original teaching assumptions: VS feed=1500 kg/d; digester volume=1000 m³. Model OLR=MVS/V gives 1.5 kg VS/(m³·d). Applicability: Organic loading only, not an allowable limit; VS and COD are distinct bases.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「有機容積負荷」的觀測點。量進料體積與 VS、並與溫度及酸鹼趨勢配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for organic volumetric loading. Measure feed volume and VS and pair with temperature/acidity trends. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只依槽容增加進料。診斷與介入：查 VS 進料與有效槽容，將酸鹼及產氣趨勢一同判讀。~Increasing feed solely because volume is available fails. Diagnostic response: Check VS feed/effective volume together with acidity and gas trends.
units.misconception: 負荷越高產氣一定同比增加。~Higher loading always raises gas production proportionally.
units.practice: 只改變 MVS:1500→1800 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1.5 變為 1.8 kg VS/(m³·d)。用「有機容積負荷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only MVS:1500→1800 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1.5 to 1.8 kg VS/(m³·d). Explain the direction using organic volumetric loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 有效消化時間~Effective digestion time
units.mechanism: 沉積、浮渣及短流減少有效空間，名義停留不足以證明穩定化。~Deposits, scum and bypass reduce effective space; nominal residence does not prove stabilization.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1000 m³；Q=50 m³/d。模型 θ=V/Q，代入得到 20 d。適用邊界：均勻流體名義停留時間；固體停留與有效容積可能不同。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1000 m³; Q=50 m³/d. Model θ=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Nominal fluid residence time; solids residence and effective volume may differ.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「有效消化時間」的觀測點。用實際進出料紀錄及槽內沉積估計有效容積。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective digestion time. Use feed/discharge records and sediment accumulation to estimate effective volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把總槽容都算成有效消化容積。診斷與介入：查沉積與浮渣占據空間，重估有效停留。~Counting the whole vessel as effective volume overestimates residence. Diagnostic response: Check volume lost to deposits/scum and re-estimate effective residence.
units.misconception: 平均停留時間可證明每粒污泥都完成處理。~Mean residence proves every particle is treated.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:50→60 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 20 變為 16.666667 d。用「有效消化時間」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:50→60 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 20 to 16.666667 d. Explain the direction using effective digestion time, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 揮發固體轉化~Volatile-solids conversion
units.mechanism: 用進出 VS 質量比較降解，不能直接相減兩個 VS 百分率。~Compare input/output VS mass rather than subtracting VS percentages.
units.model: 原創教學假設：VS 進入=1500、排出=900 kg/d。模型 VSremoved=Min-Mout，代入得到 600 kg VS/d。適用邊界：質量基準必須一致；只比較 VS 百分比會受礦物稀釋影響。~Original teaching assumptions: VS input=1500, output=900 kg/d. Model VSremoved=Min-Mout gives 600 kg VS/d. Applicability: Use a common mass basis; percentages alone are distorted by mineral dilution.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「揮發固體轉化」的觀測點。以流量乘乾固體與 VS 分率建立兩端質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for volatile-solids conversion. Calculate inlet/outlet masses using flow, dry solids and VS fractions. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 礦物比例變動造成假去除率。診斷與介入：以體積、乾固體及 VS 分率重建進出質量。~Mineral-fraction changes create apparent removal. Diagnostic response: Rebuild inlet/outlet masses from volume, dry solids and VS fraction.
units.misconception: VS 百分率下降就等於相同質量去除率。~A VS-percent decline equals the same mass removal.
units.practice: 只改變 VSout:900→1000 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 600 變為 500 kg VS/d。用「揮發固體轉化」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only VSout:900→1000 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 600 to 500 kg VS/d. Explain the direction using volatile-solids conversion, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 產甲烷潛勢~Methane potential
units.mechanism: 有機物轉化與氣體回收是不同步驟，溶解甲烷、漏氣及菌體合成形成差額。~Conversion and gas recovery differ; dissolved methane, leakage and biomass create discrepancies.
units.model: 原創教學假設：被轉化 COD=800 kg/d；假設產率=0.35 m³ CH4/kg COD。模型 VCH4=Y×COD，代入得到 280 m³ CH4/d。適用邊界：以指定標準溫壓及完全轉化的教學理論值；非實際保證產氣。~Original teaching assumptions: Converted COD=800 kg/d; assumed yield=0.35 m³ CH4/kg COD. Model VCH4=Y×COD gives 280 m³ CH4/d. Applicability: Teaching theoretical value at a stated standard condition and complete conversion, not guaranteed gas production.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「產甲烷潛勢」的觀測點。校正氣體溫壓、甲烷分率與溶解甲烷漏項。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for methane potential. Normalize gas temperature/pressure, methane fraction and dissolved-methane losses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 理論產率直接當保證產氣。診斷與介入：把氣體標準狀態與甲烷比例校正，另列溶解和漏失項。~Theoretical yield is treated as guaranteed gas output. Diagnostic response: Normalize gas conditions/methane fraction and separately list dissolved and leakage losses.
units.misconception: 全部 COD 去除都變成可回收甲烷。~All removed COD becomes recovered methane.
units.practice: 只改變 COD:800→1000 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 280 變為 350 m³ CH4/d。用「產甲烷潛勢」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only COD:800→1000 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 280 to 350 m³ CH4/d. Explain the direction using methane potential, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 酸鹼穩定性趨勢~Acidity and buffering trends
units.mechanism: VFA 上升須與鹼度、產氣與進料事件共同判讀。~Interpret rising VFA with alkalinity, gas production and feed events.
units.model: 原創教學假設：VFA=300 mg/L（以乙酸當量）；鹼度=3000 mg/L（以 CaCO3）。模型 R=VFA/Alkalinity，代入得到 0.1 reported-basis ratio。適用邊界：兩種分析基準不同，此值只供同方法趨勢比較；不得套用未驗證通用界線。~Original teaching assumptions: VFA=300 mg/L as acetic-acid equivalent; alkalinity=3000 mg/L as CaCO3. Model R=VFA/Alkalinity gives 0.1 reported-basis ratio. Applicability: Different analytical bases; use only consistent-method trend comparison, not an unverified universal limit.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「酸鹼穩定性趨勢」的觀測點。保留兩種滴定方法、換算基準與採樣溫度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for acidity and buffering trends. Retain both titration methods, reporting bases and sampling temperature. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只因 pH 尚正常而忽略酸累積。診斷與介入：用相同分析法追蹤時間序列，對照進料、產氣及 pH。~Normal pH can conceal accumulating acids. Diagnostic response: Track a same-method time series against feed, gas and pH.
units.misconception: 單一酸鹼比可通用所有消化槽。~One acid/alkalinity ratio applies to all digesters.
units.practice: 只改變 VFA:300→600 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.1 變為 0.2 reported-basis ratio。用「酸鹼穩定性趨勢」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only VFA:300→600 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.1 to 0.2 reported-basis ratio. Explain the direction using acidity and buffering trends, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 進料顯熱~Feed sensible heating
units.mechanism: 加熱負荷隨含水量與進料溫度變化，過量稀釋增加熱需求。~Heating varies with moisture and feed temperature; dilution increases thermal demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：污泥質量 m=1000 kg；cp=4 kJ/(kg·K)；ΔT=20 K。模型 Q=m cp ΔT，代入得到 80 MJ。適用邊界：顯熱近似，不含散熱、相變與容器升溫。~Original teaching assumptions: Sludge mass m=1000 kg; cp=4 kJ/(kg·K); ΔT=20 K. Model Q=m cp ΔT gives 80 MJ. Applicability: Sensible-heat approximation, excluding heat losses, phase change and vessel heating.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「進料顯熱」的觀測點。對照進出口溫度、質量及熱媒供應量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed sensible heating. Compare inlet/outlet temperatures, mass and heating-medium supply. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只計反應溫度而漏掉冷進料。診斷與介入：更新進料量、含水率和溫度，再核對熱損及回收。~Considering reactor temperature alone misses cold-feed load. Diagnostic response: Update feed, moisture and temperature and check heat loss/recovery.
units.misconception: 同槽容就有固定加熱需求。~Equal digester volume implies fixed heat demand.
units.practice: 只改變 ΔT:20→25 K，其餘假設固定；結果應由 80 變為 100 MJ。用「進料顯熱」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only ΔT:20→25 K, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 80 to 100 MJ. Explain the direction using feed sensible heating, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 混合與死角~Mixing and inactive zones
units.mechanism: 混合使熱與底物分布，但過度剪切或表面浮渣仍需單獨診斷。~Mixing distributes heat/substrate, while excessive shear and surface scum need separate diagnosis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效容積=1000 m³；乾固體濃度=40 kg/m³。模型 MDS=VC，代入得到 40000 kg DS。適用邊界：混合均勻的庫存近似；不能由總庫存推定混合均勻。~Original teaching assumptions: Effective volume=1000 m³; dry-solids concentration=40 kg/m³. Model MDS=VC gives 40000 kg DS. Applicability: Inventory approximation for a mixed vessel; total inventory does not prove mixing uniformity.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「混合與死角」的觀測點。比較不同深度與位置的乾固體濃度並扣除沉積死區。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for mixing and inactive zones. Compare dry-solids concentration by depth/location and account for deposited dead zones. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以攪拌器銘牌判定全槽均勻。診斷與介入：比較多深度固體與溫度，將沉積死區納入模型。~Nameplate mixer power does not prove uniformity. Diagnostic response: Compare depth-resolved solids/temperature and include deposited dead zones.
units.misconception: 攪拌越強消化必定越快。~Stronger mixing always accelerates digestion.
units.practice: 只改變 C:40→45 kg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 40000 變為 45000 kg DS。用「混合與死角」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:40→45 kg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 40000 to 45000 kg DS. Explain the direction using mixing and inactive zones, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 消化回流水氮~Digestion return-liquid nitrogen
units.mechanism: 蛋白質轉化後釋出的氨會回到水線，須列入整廠氮負荷。~Ammonium released from protein conversion returns to the water line and belongs in the plant nitrogen balance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：回流水 Q=80 m³/d；NH4-N=600 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：日平均回流負荷；瞬時排放會造成更高的時段尖峰。~Original teaching assumptions: Return liquid Q=80 m³/d; NH4-N=600 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: Daily mean recycle load; batch discharge causes larger short-term peaks.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「消化回流水氮」的觀測點。記錄脫水運行時段、回流量與氨氮。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for digestion return-liquid nitrogen. Record dewatering hours, recycle flow and ammonium. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 忽略脫水回流造成主流突然氨負荷。診斷與介入：將側流量與氨氮同步採樣，納入主流水線負荷。~Ignoring dewatering returns creates unexpected mainstream ammonium peaks. Diagnostic response: Sample sidestream flow/ammonium synchronously and include them in mainstream load.
units.misconception: 消化槽把所有氮都變成沼氣。~Digestion converts all nitrogen into biogas.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:80→100 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 48 變為 60 kg N/d。用「消化回流水氮」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:80→100 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 48 to 60 kg N/d. Explain the direction using digestion return-liquid nitrogen, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 可用能源與交接~Usable energy and handoff
units.mechanism: 產氣量、甲烷濃度、發電效率及自用熱共同決定能源收益。~Gas volume, methane fraction, generation efficiency and internal heating determine energy recovery.
units.model: 原創教學假設：CH4=300 m³/d；假設熱值=35.8 MJ/m³；電效率=0.35。模型 Ee=V LHV η/3.6，代入得到 1044.1667 kWh/d。適用邊界：氣體須同溫壓、乾基；未扣設備寄生用電與停機。~Original teaching assumptions: CH4=300 m³/d; assumed heating value=35.8 MJ/m³; electric efficiency=0.35. Model Ee=V LHV η/3.6 gives 1044.1667 kWh/d. Applicability: Gas must share temperature/pressure and dry basis; parasitic power and downtime are not deducted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「可用能源與交接」的觀測點。比對標準化甲烷流量與發電機電表。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for usable energy and handoff. Compare normalized methane flow with the generator meter. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把總沼氣全當純甲烷。診斷與介入：確認甲烷體積及熱值基準，分開發電、回熱與自用。~Treating all biogas as pure methane overstates energy. Diagnostic response: Confirm methane volume/heating-value bases and separate electricity, heat and internal demand.
units.misconception: 沼氣總體積直接等於甲烷體積。~Biogas volume equals methane volume.
units.practice: 只改變 η:0.35→0.30，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1044.1667 變為 895 kWh/d。用「可用能源與交接」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only η:0.35→0.30, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1044.1667 to 895 kWh/d. Explain the direction using usable energy and handoff, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
